notes:
Order details: every measurement of the design for the order — from the order, or the design's own [skip ci]

The owner, to finish his customer's setup: 33 of the 50 measurements of his design did not come from the order (every
customer got the design's own value for them) and nothing showed which. «Order details» has a second tab, «قياسات
التصميم»: each measurement (X) of the design with its value in the order's pieces and where it came from — the order
(its XML code, its rule) or the design. Those from the design are marked; «المأخوذة من التصميم فقط» shows them alone;
the design's own value stands beside each, so a value far from it is seen. The tab's title counts both.
What the drawing program used is kept with the order (not only in its work folder).
tests/test_level7_safeguards.py (+3). The build is started after the full suite.
